SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.email, u.name, u.phone, u.profile_image_url, u.status, cp.client_type, cp.company_id, c.company_name, c.ceo_name, c.business_number, c.industry, c.address, c.website_url,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contracts con INNER JOIN project_applications app ON con.contract_id = app.application_id INNER JOIN projects p ON app.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.client_id = u.user_id AND con.contract_status = 'COMPLETED') as contract_count,
COALESCE( (SELECT AVG(con.client_rating) FROM contracts con INNER JOIN project_applications app ON con.contract_id = app.application_id INNER JOIN projects p ON app.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.client_id = u.user_id AND con.client_rating IS NOT NULL), 0 ) as avg_rating
FROM users u INNER JOIN client_profiles cp ON u.user_id = cp.client_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON cp.company_id = c.company_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.name as freelancerName, con.client_rating as rating, con.client_experience as content, DATE_FORMAT(con.contracted_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as contractedAt FROM contracts con INNER JOIN project_applications app ON con.contract_id = app.application_id INNER JOIN projects p ON app.project_id = p.project_id INNER JOIN users u ON app.freelancer_id = u.user_id WHERE p.client_id = #{userId} AND con.client_rating IS NOT NULL AND con.client_experience IS NOT NULL ORDER BY con.contracted_at DESC LIMIT 5
